accepted.title: PromisedDate must not precede CreatedDate
accepted.contract: PromisedDate is the promised delivery date - a commitment made at or after the order is created.
accepted.rationale: TMP-005 checks DeliveredDate against CreatedDate but nothing checks PromisedDate. A promise dated before the order exists makes every on-time-delivery metric meaningless, and it is the kind of value a backfill or a timezone bug produces.

accepted.title: Every event must record the actor that performed it
accepted.contract: ResourceUser is the actor or system that performed the activity.
accepted.rationale: No existing rule touches ResourceUser. Process mining attributes work to resources; a blank actor silently collapses into an 'unknown' bucket and distorts any handover or workload analysis.

quarantined.title: CustomerId must match the documented CUST-## format
quarantined.rationale: REF-002 asserts the OrderId format but nothing asserts CustomerId. A malformed customer key breaks any join to a customer master.

reasons: silent on every labelled defect - the gate cannot confirm it detects anything, so a fixture is needed before it can be trusted

rejected.title: CustomerName must be identical on both sides
reasons: fires on 1 row(s) the contract says are correct: customer name differing only by case and trailing whitespace - contract says equal

rejected.title: Discount code must be present on discounted orders
